scientific_integrity.computational_support: independent exact finite tests supplement an analytic proof; experiments are not infinite certificates
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: all integers Delta≥3 and all finite connected simple unit-weight graphs of maximum degree at most Delta, with finite-tree sharpness for every supercritical step

scientific_limitations: Only unit-conductance simple undirected finite graphs, combinatorial Laplacian, and fixed one-step trapezoidal update.
Global threshold uniform over all bounded-degree graphs, not the individual graph-specific optimal step.
Infinite sharpness proved by a sequence of finite tree balls; no fixed finite tree is claimed sharp at the boundary.
The publication-priority comparison is limited to inspected sources.
title: Sharp maximum-degree Crank–Nicolson positivity via regular-tree returns
